This editor changes Android’s shared System, Secure and Global settings. Global settings can affect every user on this device.

Incorrect changes can disrupt the display, keyboard, accessibility, networking or debugging, stop apps working, or prevent Android from starting normally. Only change values you understand.

Android or your device manufacturer may ignore or replace saved values. Undo restores a recorded value; it cannot guarantee every effect is reversible. Recovery may require ADB, recovery mode or a factory reset.
